name: CPU %
description: CPU cores used (2-minute timeshift delta) / kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=cpu}, as a percentage.
programText:
raw = data('container_cpu_usage_seconds_total', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'schemaregistry-0')).sum()
usage = (raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120
limit = data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'schemaregistry-0') and filter('resource', 'cpu') and filter('container', 'schemaregistry')).sum()
(usage/limit*100).publish(label='CPU %')
